name: Aldeaseca de la Frontera (Spain)
description: Square flag divided per saltire, white above and below and red at the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Aldeaseca de la Frontera (ears of wheat on red and a chevron on white).
history: Municipal flag of Aldeaseca de la Frontera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
